tasks.label: Infra: Create Network (Safe)
tasks.command: docker network inspect infra-storage >/dev/null 2>&1 || docker network create --driver bridge --subnet 172.25.0.0/24 infra-storage
tasks.detail: Checks if infra-storage exists; creates it only if missing.

tasks.label: Infra: Delete Network
tasks.detail: Forcefully removes the shared infra-storage network.

tasks.label: Infra: Total Reset (Compose Down + Cleanup)
tasks.command: docker compose down --remove-orphans && docker container prune -f && docker image prune -f
tasks.detail: Stops infra, removes orphaned containers and dangling images. Leaves network intact.

tasks.label: Infra: Backup Firefly III Database
tasks.command: set -a && source .env && set +a && docker exec -t ${FIN_DB_SERVICE_NAME} pg_dump -U ${POSTGRES_USER} -d ${POSTGRES_DB} > firefly_backup.sql
